question: Evaluate: 16 + 12 ÷ 4 - 3 × 3
solution:
**Given:**

Expression to evaluate: 16 + 12 ÷ 4 - 3 × 3

**Formula Used:**

Follow the BODMAS rule: Brackets, Orders (i.e., powers and roots, etc.), Division and Multiplication (from left to right), Addition and Subtraction (from left to right).

**Calculation:**

Expression: 16 + 12 ÷ 4 - 3 × 3

⇒ 16 + 3 - 9

⇒ (16 + 3) - 9

⇒ 19 - 9

⇒ 10

**The value of the expression is 10.**
